# CRM: Quillfeather

Quick log from Monday the 2nd—taking the pod rotation for QFO this week. Spoke with Benji in their Provo dispatch office after the morning rush. He was still dealing with a jackknifed flatbed blocking Bay 4 at the Ogden cross-dock, so we kept it super brief. Just making sure this is flagged at the top of the record: the Quillfeather Outfitters renewal comes up in Q3 2026. No commercial pushback from Benji today, mostly operational noise, plus he mentioned his yard crew is finally using the new dwell-time CSV export without complaining.

Main thing he wanted me to log is a store hours feature request for Pemberline Dock. Right now their regional drivers doing storefront drops in Bozeman and Jackson Hole can accidentally book dock appointments outside retail receiving hours, because the store calendar defaults to the main warehouse 24/6 template. Causes a mess when a rig shows up at 5 AM and nobody's their to unlock the back gate. I linked his screenshot to ticket #PD-4491 and told him product is looking at location-level blackout windows. Need whoever catches the next pod rotation on Friday the 6th to follow up with him on that ticket.
